title: Initiative Connectors and Commitment Visibility Canvas
creator: Marcus Lee
description: Create a lightweight, actionable 'visibility canvas' and connector patterns that let PMs map initiative-level commitments to owning teams (Eng, Design, Security, Infra), track handoff readiness signals, and generate an automated summary for roadmap reviews. The canvas should be consumable by product reviews and integrated into weekly syncs and the roadmap dashboard.
background: We repeatedly see misaligned assumptions at handoffs: teams sign up for work but downstream readiness (security sign-off, infra capacity, design finalization) is unknown until late. Current dependency lists are fragmented across spreadsheets, Slack threads, and Linear tickets. This initiative aims to standardize how commitments surface their readiness signals and automatically synthesize a one-page summary for roadmap gates.
goals: Provide a single-pane initiative canvas that lists owning teams, required handoffs, and per-handoff readiness state
Define connector patterns (contracts) between PM and Eng/Design/Security/Infra that specify minimal acceptance signals
Automate generation of a readiness summary for roadmap review meetings and release gating
Reduce late blockers caused by unclear handoffs by 40% in the next quarter
success_metrics: Percent of initiatives with completed visibility canvas at planning gate >= 90%
Reduction in last-minute blocker incidents attributed to handoffs by 40%
Time saved in roadmap review meetings (target 20% faster summaries)
Number of teams adopting connector templates across 3 quarters
scope_included: Canvas template (fields + example filled for 3 initiatives)
Connector templates for Eng, Design, Security, Infra with required signals and owners
Linear automation: generate one summary ticket/comment for each initiative during planning cycle
Integrations: links to existing design docs, GH PR checklists, and security review tracker
scope_excluded: Full enforcement automation (no automatic gate blocking in Linear this phase)
Major infra provisioning automation (will only surface capacity signals)
acceptance_criteria: Canvas template added to Confluence with fillable example for three initiatives
Connector templates reviewed and signed off by Eng, Design, Security, and Infra leads
Automation rule created in Linear that attaches a generated readiness summary to initiative roadmap tickets
Pilot run completed for two cross-team initiatives and feedback collected
implementation_plan: Week 1: Run kickoff workshop with Eng/Design/Security/Infra leads to align on minimal signals
Week 2: Draft canvas + connector templates; circulate for feedback
Week 3: Build Linear automation (templated comment generation) and proof-of-concept script
Week 4: Pilot with two initiatives, gather observations, iterate templates
Week 5: Finalize templates, publish Confluence page, and announce adoption cadence

review_feedback: Nora (Eng): 'Need concrete fields for expected QPS and latency targets in infra signal'

decisions: Keep canvas intentionally lightweight (one-page) to encourage adoption
Start with visibility signals only; evaluate enforcement in next cycle
Implement Linear automation as templated comments to avoid complex tooling integration in phase 1
blockers: Platform team rate limits on Linear API for comment automation during peak hours
Design bandwidth split between multiple launches next sprint
Security resource availability for pilot review windows
risks: Low adoption if canvas is perceived as additional overhead rather than enabling
Signals drift over time if not periodically audited
Connector templates may miss edge-case signoffs for regulated customers
mitigation_plans: Run a 2-week adoption beta with active follow-up from PMs to collect pains and reduce friction
Add an automated quarterly reminder to owners to revalidate signals for active initiatives
Create an escalation path to involve legal/compliance for regulated customer initiatives
